Reading the question in CA exams:

The question will always 2 aspects: to trick you and to also hint towards the facts.

You will only be able to identify this after lot of written practice. Watch this 👇

comment: Exam success in Direct Tax often depends on reading beyond the provision—understanding why a fact is included helps distinguish a genuine issue from a deliberate distraction.
